0.1.620: Simulator: The top of the tree page was reworked. 0.1.619: The first screen now shows without waiting for the web fonts to load

0.1.616: Simulator: Text that was cut off with "…" now wraps to show in full: long craft tags, the bottom bar and recipes page on narrow phones (such as 320px), and the list of what is missing in the right column. The blog and channel section is no longer shown on the recipes page on phones
0.1.615: Simulator: The list of what is missing, the minimap and the zoom tools moved to a column outside the tree frame on the right, so they no longer cover boxes or labels in the tree
0.1.614: Simulator: "Fit all" now fits every box instead of cutting off the bottom rows. Also fixed the "MOD" tag in the finished-item settings slipping under its header, the box popup running into the zoom tools at the bottom right, and omen icons overlapping each other

Simulator: Tree notes are now text only (the desired-mod and currency fields were removed; existing notes still load)
0.1.613: Simulator: The mod list inside tree boxes now looks like the finished item (separator art, centered text). Tags such as Alloy or Essence sit on the same line as the mod when they fit

Simulator: Box labels (e.g. "◎ … added", "Miss") now sit at the top center of the frame and no longer overlap the undecided "!". The "<1% + next craft" text inside boxes was removed

0.1.611: Phone: On narrow screens (such as 320px wide), the header's Guide and Feedback buttons were cut off on the right; the header is now tightened so everything fits without hiding anything

0.1.609: Simulator (phone): A tree overview at the bottom (the current box glows; lines show connections only). Result items start expanded, and the page scrolls to the omens when they appear

Simulator: Boxes were redesigned. Boxes where a target landed take the next craft via +, and only miss boxes offer "Retry"

When some of the 100 runs get stuck, the reason is shown on the box

Simulator: Crafts with no target now also show a box for when a target mod lands ("After" is only for when none does). After adding a final mod midway, picking an earlier craft again adds only the missing hit boxes. Return arrows removed with × no longer come back by themselves

Simulator: Boxes whose target was removed from the final mods are marked, and opening a mod you can't pick in the final-mod table shows why. Coming back from the final mods keeps your previous view. Simulator: When picking a craft, the held currency now follows the cursor like in the Emulator. The automatic reload right after a new version no longer loses your unsaved tree

Phone: Text is no longer cut off (shelf names, base list, card notes, the held currency's description and more), and the mod and base lists start fully expanded. 0.1.557: Added the “Learn desecration” tutorial: 4 Bones and revealing, Necromancy, Abyssal Echoes, faction omens (with a list of that faction’s mods for the item), Omen of Light, Essence of the Abyss and Omen of Putrefaction

0.1.556: Fixed omens from the previous tutorial step staying applied after moving to another step

Tutorial text now names the rarity next to each colour: white (Normal), blue (Magic), yellow (Rare)
0.1.552: “Get the app” in the top bar (PC) now installs ExileDesk as a desktop app (same as the web version). Pages you have opened once also work offline
0.1.551: Tutorials are live, starting with "Learn the basic orbs": use Transmutation, Augmentation, Regal, Alchemy, Exalted, Chaos, Annulment, Fracturing and Divine Orbs (Greater / Perfect too) one at a time over 19 steps to see what each does and what mod levels can roll
Moved the usage-logging note and its switch from the page footer into the Privacy Policy
0.1.550: In the mod list, "Add" now lets you choose how to add (Normal / Fracture / Desecrated / Essence). Options already used on the item are hidden
0.1.549: Opening a shared chaos spam result from X now opens the Chaos spam calculator right away with the same item and targets
0.1.548: English: release notes are now shown in English, and the base pages are available in English (/en/bases/)
0.1.547: Omen of Sanctification: values are now rerolled like a Divine Orb before being multiplied by 0.78–1.22 (previously the multiplier was applied to the current values). Values can exceed the tier's range
0.1.546: Resistance Flux and Aldur runes now also convert Essence-made mods and base-specific mods, the same way as regular mods (previously they stayed unchanged)
0.1.545: With a Mark of the Abyssal Lord on the item, a bone always replaces the Mark, so Sinistral / Dextral Necromancy omens are no longer used (and not consumed)

0.1.544: Omen of Light and Sinistral / Dextral Annulment can no longer be active together (only Light is used)
0.1.543: Added a "Keep omens after use" switch (in the omen box when holding currency, and on the Omens tab). While on, omens like Whittling stay active so you can keep using Chaos Orbs. The omen's cost is still added each time
0.1.542: Wands, staves and sceptres now have the quality field above the item (− / + / Max). Quality can be raised with currency or the field alike
0.1.541: Blacksmith's Whetstone, Arcanist's Etcher and Armourer's Scrap are back on the currency shelf (shown only for items they can be used on)

0.1.540: Catalysts, Blacksmith's Whetstone, Arcanist's Etcher and Armourer's Scrap now add +1% or +2% quality per use (random). Catalysts used to fill quality to the cap in one click; now you use them one at a time (you can still set the number directly in the quality field)
0.1.538: Chaos spam calculator: a hit now means "any one" of the selected mods lands (previously all of them). Up to 3 targets. Even rare mods finish calculating in a few seconds
0.1.537: Chaos spam calculator: the currency shelf is locked while it is open ("Close the calculator" over the shelf). The small × in the top right is now a "Close" button
Chaos spam calculator: targets nobody hits no longer calculate for minutes; it gives up if the first 10 people all miss (shows "many people never hit")
0.1.536: Chaos spam calculator: going back to an item level you already calculated shows the result immediately. It recalculates when you add or change target mods and when you close the calculator (your own spam always uses fresh random numbers)
0.1.535: Chaos spam calculator: fixed switching the Chaos Orb type after spamming restarting the calculation and blocking spam. With the same target mods the previous result is reused, and you return to the pre-spam state to try another Chaos Orb right away. Changing the item level or targets also recalculates from the pre-spam state
0.1.534: Chaos spam calculator (renamed from the spam odds tool): once targets are set it calculates Chaos Orb, Greater and Perfect, and picks the one with the lowest cost for half of people to hit as "Recommended". You can't spam until the calculation finishes (requested on YouTube)

Target mod picker: rows that group several mods (spell / minion / melee / projectile skill levels) now open the tier table when checked so you choose which to target (previously projectile +1 was targeted)

Cards: added that Crystallisation omens also work with corrupted essences (Hysteria etc.) and alloys, what Astrid's Creativity's crafted mods are, and the Catalysing Exaltation multiplier (5x at 20%). Updated the Contempt / Ferocity cards to the current rule (version is random)
0.1.533: Liquid emotions (Contempt / Ferocity): whether the prefix or suffix version is added is now random (the description doesn't say; previously it followed the side of the removed mod)
0.1.532: Essence of the Abyss: usable when the item has an Unrevealed Desecrated mod, and the Mark replaces that Unrevealed mod. Not usable with a revealed Desecrated mod (confirmed in game)
0.1.531: Bones on a Mark of the Abyssal Lord now have a minimum tier of "item level × 0.4" (same as Craft of Exile; previously fixed at 33)
Fixed the Essence of the Abyss description (usable even with a Desecrated mod)
0.1.530: Re-recorded the currency sounds from the game (Whetstone, Scrap, runes, omens and more have their own sounds; bones pick from 5). Volumes are matched and rapid use no longer overlaps
Desecrated mods in the mod list now show their faction (Amanamu / Kurgal / Ulaman) tag from the start
0.1.529: Whetstone, Etcher and Scrap now add +1% quality each (previously +1% or +2% at random)
0.1.528: All Desecrated-only mods are now equally likely (the game doesn't publish the odds; previously based on community measurements on rings and estimates from them)
0.1.527: Changing the item level while using the chaos spam tool now records an "item level change" step (replays used to produce a different item)
0.1.526: Emulator: values boosted by quality are now rounded (previously truncated, same as Craft of Exile)
Flux and Aldur runes now only convert mods in the game's conversion table (other mods stay unchanged)
Essence of the Abyss can now be used on items with a Desecrated mod
0.1.525: Emulator: bones now follow Craft of Exile (50/50 when both sides are open; when both are full, one non-Fractured mod is removed at random and the bone goes on that side)
Omen of Light and Sinistral / Dextral Annulment can now be active together (removes only the Desecrated mod on that side)
Omen of Catalysing Exaltation multiplier is now 1 + 0.2 × quality (5x at 20%)
0.1.524: Closed the message board for now
0.1.523: Emulator: rebuilt currency behaviour to follow the game's descriptions (results are almost unchanged)
Artificer's Orb can no longer be used on sceptres, and socketing a rune clears Hinekora's Lock foresight (as described)

Fixed sounds no longer playing on phones after a call etc.

Phones: the "Use" button in the bottom bar now uses the game's button art

Greater / Perfect currency cards now show "Only mod level ◯+ tiers" prominently at the top
